subject: Fix error "SSL routines::bad length" when connTLSWrite is called second time with smaller buffer (#1737)
reason: The change is confined to src/tls.c (connTLSWrite/connTLSWritev): it only executes on a TLS connection, which requires a BUILD_TLS build, a tls-port with certificates, and a TLS client or TLS replication link.
